title: Receive calls in the browser
summary: A subscriber is a Fabric resource with an address of its own, and a subscriber token is what a browser registers with. A SWML connect to that address is the document that sends a call to the registered browser.
scenario: A workshop mechanic who takes the shop's calls at a laptop, with no desk phone

evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/fabric/resources/subscribers: email required; GET {id}/addresses: name, channels
tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/fabric/subscribers/tokens: reference required; subscriber_id, token, refresh_token
schema.json ConnectDeviceSingle.to lists a Call Fabric Resource address
